---
title: "Spotify 2023 Top Hits"
output: html_notebook
---
```{r}
library(readxl)
spotify <- read_excel("~/Desktop/MKT Data Debrief/spotify-2023.xlsx")
str(spotify)
```
```{r}
# # Create logged versions of streams and playlists, then plot the raw relationship to check its shape
spotify$log_streams   <- log(spotify$streams)
spotify$log_playlists <- log(spotify$in_spotify_playlists + 1)

plot(spotify$in_spotify_playlists, spotify$streams,
     xlab = "Spotify playlists", ylab = "Streams",
     main = "Raw")
```

```{r}
# Remove 1 record with a corrupted streams value (Que Vuelvas, 2,762 streams)
spotify <- spotify[spotify$streams > 10000, ]
nrow(spotify)
```

```{r}
# Re-plot on the log scale to confirm a clean linear relationship
plot(spotify$log_playlists, spotify$log_streams,
     xlab = "log(playlists)", ylab = "log(streams)")
```

```{r}
# Regress streams on playlist placement, controlling for three audio features
m <- lm(log_streams ~ log_playlists + `danceability_%` + `energy_%` + `valence_%`,
        data = spotify)
summary(m)
```
```{r}
# Compare fit with and without audio features to see how much they actually add
m_simple <- lm(log_streams ~ log_playlists, data = spotify)
summary(m_simple)$r.squared
summary(m)$r.squared
```

```{r}
# Standardize all variables so coefficients can be compared on the same scale
vars <- c("log_streams","log_playlists","danceability_%","energy_%","valence_%")
z <- as.data.frame(scale(spotify[, vars]))
names(z) <- c("log_streams","log_playlists","dance","energy","valence")
m_std <- lm(log_streams ~ log_playlists + dance + energy + valence, data = z)
round(coef(m_std), 3)
```

```{r}
# Calculate each predictor's share of the explained variance
library(relaimpo)
imp <- calc.relimp(m, type = "lmg", rela = TRUE)
round(imp$lmg * 100, 2)
```

```{r}
png("scatter.png", width = 1600, height = 1300, res = 200)
par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 1, 1))
plot(spotify$log_playlists, spotify$log_streams,
     xlab = "log(playlists)", ylab = "log(streams)",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0.11, 0.73, 0.33, 0.45), cex = 0.7)
abline(lm(log_streams ~ log_playlists, data = spotify), col = "#C8102E", lwd = 2.5)
dev.off()
```
